summary: Technology executive with 25 years in engineering and 12+ years in C-level and VP roles, building and leading technology organisations across EdTech, media and OTT, e-commerce, sports and global banking.

Track record of taking platforms from concept to commercialisation, modernising legacy estates onto cloud-native architectures, and embedding AI into how the business actually operates — while cutting run-cost and holding availability above 98%.
highlights: Cut annual technology operating cost by more than 50% — from ₹3 Cr to ₹1.3 Cr — while raising service availability above 98%.
Serving 60+ university partners and 600,000+ students as CTO of India's leading Work-Linked Degree platform.
Built and led technology organisations of 20, 35, 40 and 66 people; peak span of 150+ technologists across India and the UK.
Took an OTT and blockchain product from 0 to 10,000 users and stood up its digital advertising revenue line from scratch.

experience.title: Chief Technology Officer
experience.context: India's largest Work-Linked Degree platform — 60+ university partners, 600,000+ students. Reporting to the Founder & CEO with full ownership of technology strategy, architecture and execution across a 15-system estate.
bullets: Own the technology function end to end — engineering, product, infrastructure, data, security and the technology budget — for a business preparing for institutional fundraise and IPO readiness.

Leading UMS 2.0 platform modernisation: migrating the core University Management System from a legacy .NET monolith to microservices on React and .NET Core using the Strangler Fig pattern, de-risking the platform without a big-bang cutover.

Delivered a data warehouse and business intelligence layer that closed long-standing data-integrity and reporting gaps affecting 60+ university clients, giving leadership a single reconciled view of admissions, revenue and delivery.

Launched AI-driven student engagement — voice-AI lead qualification through a strategic partner, an AI call-analysis pipeline, and a proprietary AI Mock Interview platform — positioning the company as an AI-native EdTech player.
Institutionalised AI-assisted engineering and workflow automation (n8n) across the organisation, lifting delivery velocity and letting non-technical teams automate their own operations.

Rebuilt technology governance: consolidated telephony and SaaS vendors, introduced maker-checker controls on production configuration, and put a DPDP-readiness programme in place ahead of the 2027 deadline.

experience.title: Head of Technology & VP Engineering

bullets: Led a 66-member technology organisation across engineering, DevOps, QA and operations, owning the architecture and delivery of every consumer-facing and partner-facing service.

Reduced technology operating expenditure by more than 50%, from ₹3 Cr to ₹1.3 Cr annually, through cloud right-sizing, contract renegotiation and workload consolidation — with no reduction in service quality.
Re-platformed the technology stack onto Kubernetes and CNCF tooling, replacing a fragmented legacy estate with a standardised, observable, horizontally scalable platform.
Held SLAs above 98% uptime across all services while the platform was being rebuilt underneath, through improved release governance, monitoring and incident practice.
Drove the organisational AI strategy — deployed a no-code LLM platform and GPU infrastructure so content, marketing and operations teams could build their own AI workflows.

Defined the software architecture and stood up an agile development practice supporting both web and mobile applications.
Consolidated the fragmented SaaS and vendor estate and set the digital transformation roadmap for the organisation.

paragraphs: I am writing to express my interest in a senior technology leadership role within your organisation. Over 25 years I have moved from writing core banking code in Chennai and New York to running technology functions as CTO and VP of Engineering — and the through-line has been the same throughout: take a technology estate that is holding the business back, and turn it into the thing that moves the business forward.

Most recently, as Chief Technology Officer at TeamLease EdTech, I own technology strategy and execution for India's largest Work-Linked Degree platform, serving 60+ university partners and over 600,000 students. I am leading the migration of the core University Management System off a legacy monolith onto microservices using the Strangler Fig pattern, I have delivered the data warehouse and business intelligence layer that finally gave leadership one reconciled view of the business, and I have taken AI from a slide into production — voice-AI lead qualification, AI call analysis, and an AI mock-interview platform now in the hands of students.

Before that, at Hungama Digital Media Entertainment, I led a 66-person technology organisation and reduced annual operating cost by more than half — from ₹3 Cr to ₹1.3 Cr — while re-platforming onto Kubernetes and holding availability above 98%. Cost discipline and engineering ambition are not opposites in my experience; the same architectural clarity buys you both.

What I bring is range with depth. I have built teams from zero to forty in a year, and managed a span of 150+ technologists across India and the UK. I have delivered under CMMI Level 5 and banking audit controls at HSBC and Oracle Financial Services, and I have shipped a startup product from zero to ten thousand users at Mzaalo. I have worked onsite in New York, London and Hong Kong, and I am equally comfortable in a board conversation about capital allocation and in a design review about service boundaries.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how that experience maps onto what you are building. Thank you for your time and consideration.
